tests.name: lease_generation_fencing
tests.pass_condition: expired generation 1 cannot heartbeat or submit after generation 2 claim; generation 2 uniquely commits

tests.name: recovery_count_monotonic
tests.pass_condition: recovery_count strictly increases once per accepted recovery and never regresses

tests.name: authorized_runtime_root_allowlist
tests.pass_condition: unauthorized roots, symlink escapes and traversal are rejected before mutation

tests.name: checkpoint_schema_validation
tests.pass_condition: identity, schema version, generation, recovery_count, task state and hash are validated

tests.name: checkpoint_write_failure_recovery
tests.pass_condition: no false completion; running remains recoverable; side effect is not duplicated

tests.name: canonical_task_state
tests.pass_condition: dispatcher state and filesystem location resolve to one canonical state

tests.name: completed_registry_outbox_path
tests.pass_condition: completed record contains valid outbox_path and matching result hash

tests.name: multiprocess_claim_race
tests.pass_condition: exactly one independent process claims the task

tests.name: multiprocess_submit_race
tests.pass_condition: only the current lease generation can commit

tests.name: process_restart_persistence
tests.pass_condition: new process restores running, retry, completed, generation and recovery_count from disk

tests.name: manifest_integrity
tests.pass_condition: all frozen artifacts match byte size and SHA-256; missing, extra and duplicate paths are reported

tests.name: checkpoint_hash_conflict
tests.pass_condition: tampered checkpoint is BLOCKED and quarantined without task mutation

tests.name: stale_owner_heartbeat
tests.pass_condition: generation 1 heartbeat is rejected after generation 2 recovery

tests.name: stale_owner_submit
tests.pass_condition: generation 1 submit is rejected after generation 2 recovery

tests.name: checkpoint_failure_after_side_effect
tests.pass_condition: restart reconciles one side effect into one result without false completion
